entries.name: The Fall of LV-223
entries.content: The Fall of LV-223 is Before his exile to Earth, Corinoch ruled a thriving empire of xenomorphic life on LV-223. As a fierce ruler, he controlled the evolution of the Xenomorph species. His downfall came from an unexpected cosmic force that weakened him, tearing him from his throne and sending him through dimensions. Stripped of his demonic power, he was left in his goo form, forgotten by loyal subjects but driven by a burning desire for vengeance against the force that displaced him.
